task_1_model_zoo.flame_repo: flame (torchtitan fork, referenced from fla README)
task_1_model_zoo.details: Wang et al. trained 72 models (6 linear attention archs x 5 hybridization ratios x 2 scales + 2 transformer baselines) on fineweb-edu. All single seed, no intermediate checkpoints released. Training uses fla library with flame framework (torchtitan fork). No multi-seed variants exist in the model zoo.

task_2_training_feasibility.details: Wang et al. trained 340M models on 20B fineweb-edu tokens with batch_size=50k, AdamW, cosine schedule, using flame (torchtitan fork). RTX PRO 6000 has ample VRAM (96GB) for a 340M model, but flame is distributed-first. Even the most optimistic single-GPU throughput estimate (~200k tok/s) requires 28h per seed. With setup, data download, framework adaptation, and debugging, 2 seeds in 3 days is not achievable.

within_arch_jaccard_as_proxy.argument: Within-architecture comparisons (same arch, different attention ratios) serve as an upper bound on seed variation. Our data shows within-arch Jaccard (J_helped ≈ 0.09-0.10) is flat across ratios while cross-architecture effects (sigma) are 4× larger at pure vs 3:1. The bootstrap CI analysis (bootstrap_ci_results.json) shows sigma ranges from 0.024 (pure) to 0.005 (h3-1), with non-overlapping CIs — this is architecture-driven variation, not noise.
within_arch_jaccard_as_proxy.strength: STRONG — permutation test with z=6-9 rules out chance. Within-arch J stability rules out ratio as a confound. The gap between within-arch and cross-arch sigma IS the architecture effect signal.

public_multi_seed_models.name: Pythia PolyPythias (EleutherAI)
public_multi_seed_models.relevance: HIGH — 410m is closest to our 340M. Provides ground truth for how much seed variation exists in Transformers. Can compute Jaccard between seed variants as a calibration baseline.
public_multi_seed_models.limitation: These are all standard Transformers (GPT-NeoX), not hybrid recurrent architectures. But they establish the seed-variation floor for the Transformer baseline we already include.

public_multi_seed_models.name: OLMo 2 (AI2)
public_multi_seed_models.seeds_per_size: 3-4 annealing variants (not true multi-seed from scratch)
public_multi_seed_models.relevance: LOW — different training stages, not independent seed runs. Too large for our setting.
public_multi_seed_models.limitation: Annealing variants ≠ true multi-seed training runs

bootstrap_proxy.description: Evaluation-level bootstrap resampling provides a lower bound on measurement noise
bootstrap_proxy.existing_data: bootstrap_ci_results.json shows tight CIs for J_helped/J_hurt (~±0.01), confirming that observed cross-architecture Jaccard is well above evaluation noise
bootstrap_proxy.strength: MODERATE — establishes that measurement noise alone cannot explain the observed patterns

pythia_seed_experiment_plan.description: Download Pythia 410m seed1-seed9, run the same LAMBADA/ARC-Easy evaluations, compute within-seed Jaccard. If Pythia seed-Jaccard << our cross-architecture Jaccard, this proves architecture effect dominates seed noise.
pythia_seed_experiment_plan.estimated_time: ~2-4 hours (9 models × 410m × eval only, no training)
pythia_seed_experiment_plan.feasibility: HIGH — only requires model download + inference. 410m fits easily on RTX PRO 6000.
pythia_seed_experiment_plan.value: VERY HIGH — directly addresses the reviewer concern with empirical evidence from established multi-seed models

task_3_alternatives.recommendation: Run Pythia 410m multi-seed experiment (2-4 hours) as the primary seed-variation calibration. Combine with existing within-arch analysis and permutation tests for a three-pronged defense: (1) Pythia seed-Jaccard as empirical seed-noise calibration, (2) within-arch ratio stability as architecture-internal control, (3) permutation null z=6-9 as statistical significance.

overall_recommendation: Training new seeds is NOT feasible before May 25. The strongest actionable strategy is to run Pythia 410m (9 seeds) through our evaluation pipeline (~2-4 hours). This provides direct empirical evidence for seed variation magnitude in Transformers at comparable scale. Combined with our existing permutation tests (z=6-9, p<0.0001) and within-architecture stability analysis, this creates a compelling three-part defense against the seed-variation concern. The Pythia experiment should be started immediately.
